bc.title: Who is the mystery player?
bc.lede: Sealed clues, one at a time. Name the man before the clock — and every extra clue — runs you down.
bc.bank.small: A small bank: {n} mysteries so far, so a mystery can come round again.
bc.daily.title: Today's mystery
bc.daily.sub: One for everybody. A new one at midnight ({zone}).
bc.daily.over: Revealed today. A new one at midnight.
bc.solo.title: Quick mystery
bc.solo.sub: A random player from the bank.
bc.duel.title: Challenge a friend
bc.duel.sub: Same mystery, same rules. Send the link, compare the times.
bc.duel.beatMiss: They could not name him. Can you?
bc.duel.note: No server in the middle: each time is reported by each player's own device, on trust.
bc.howto.1: One clue is open. Every further clue costs 15 seconds.
bc.howto.2: Name the player from the search list. Each wrong guess costs 5 seconds.
bc.howto.3: A quick mystery has no time limit — the clock only counts. A challenge stops at 120 seconds. The lowest weighted time wins.
bc.howto.4: A daily mystery is the same for everybody on the club's day. A challenge is a link to the same mystery.
bc.error: That did not go through. Your clues are safe on the server — check where you are, or start fresh.
bc.drawer.title: Who is it?
bc.drawer.hint: Tap a name to guess. A wrong guess costs {s}s.
bc.verdict.long: The long way round — but you got there.
bc.ledger.title: How the time adds up
bc.vs.open: Nobody solved this one — no winner.
bc.vs.winMiss: You solved the one they could not.
bc.vs.loseMiss: They solved it, you did not.
bc.share.title: Blind Cow
bc.share.challengeText: Can you beat {time}s? Same mystery player — FAN LIFE · {club}.
bc.share.challengeOpen: Same mystery player, your own clock — FAN LIFE · {club}.
bc.share.noName: The share text never names the player.
bc.res.tomorrow: Come back tomorrow for the next daily.
bc.costs: Every extra clue +{clue}s · every wrong guess +{wrong}s
bc.empty: The mysteries for this club are still being prepared.
bc.locked.sub: This needs ten checked clues that narrow to one player. Not ready yet.
bc.duel.unavailable: This challenge cannot be played at this club yet.
bc.solo.explore: Exploration: the clues point to a player, but the archive cannot yet prove only one fits.
bc.explore.note: Exploration — the clues are checked, but the archive cannot prove that only one player fits them.
bc.offline: You are offline. Your run is kept on the server — reconnect to carry on.
bc.res.policy: Your first attempt of the day is the one that counts; anything after is practice.
bc.res.duelPolicy: A challenge has a hard {s}-second limit. Past it, the run closes as a miss.
bc.why.title: Why this player fits
bc.why.open: Show all {n} clues with their sources
bc.why.one: Only one player fits from here
bc.cover.unique-in-archive: Unique within this club's checked archive — that is not proof that nobody else ever fit.
bc.cover.few-candidates: A few players could fit all of these clues in the archive ({n} left); the archive's intended player is the answer.
bc.cover.unproven: The archive has not counted who else fits, so this is an exploration, not a proven single answer.
